name: jog
description: Syntax highlighting and diagnostics for Jog

jog.serverPath.description: Path to the Jog language server executable. Empty uses the bundled server, then server/out/server.exe in the JogLSP checkout.

jog.compilerPath.description: Path to jog.exe. A value set in user or workspace settings wins. Otherwise the JOG environment variable, then this default. The language server runs jog check --diag=json on the saved file and passes no --module flags.
